question.text: A Cat III AIF's hurdle was raised from 10% to 12%. As per the workbook, Year 2 incentive fees:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Example 2 conclusion, raising hurdle from 10% to 12% drops Year 2 incentive fees from Rs. 41.99 lakh to Rs. 8.69 lakh — significant decrease. The Trap: Higher hurdle REDUCES, not increases, incentive fees; no negative fees apply. Cross-Exam Context: Tested via Example 2 in the workbook. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use this sensitivity when negotiating hurdles on behalf of institutional clients.
